data.name: Privacy_Law
data.value: Republic Act No. 10173 (Data Privacy Act of 2012)

data.name: Privacy_Introduction
data.value: Davao Regional Medical Center (DRMC) handles your personal and health information when you use the DRMC Patient Portal. This notice explains what information the portal uses, how we protect it, and whom you can contact about your privacy.

data.name: Privacy_Identity
data.value: Your name, date of birth, contact details, and hospital record number. If you submit a government ID, the portal also processes the ID details and photos you provide.

data.name: Privacy_Clinical
data.value: Hospital encounters, lab and radiology results, prescriptions, and appointments, including Red Star clinic information where applicable.

data.name: Privacy_Activity
data.value: Sign-in times, network addresses, and audit records of certain account and clinical record activity.

data.name: Privacy_Purpose
data.value: We use this information to verify your identity, link your portal account to your hospital record, give you access to your records, support your care, protect the portal, and meet legal reporting obligations.

data.name: Privacy_Notifications
data.value: We use your email address for account messages, such as confirmation and password reset. You can choose to receive refill reminders by email and turn them off in the portal. The sender can show the Red Star Clinic name and email address.

data.name: Privacy_UsageCollection
data.value: When usage reporting is enabled, DRMC measures daily website reach and portal use. The portal makes temporary daily identifiers from network and browser information and uses a separate daily identifier for signed-in accounts. Usage reporting omits the original values, page addresses, and clinical information. It uses no analytics cookies or identifiers that follow you across days.

data.name: Privacy_UsageRetention
data.value: The temporary identifiers and their daily key are scheduled for removal five minutes after the next midnight in Manila. The reporting system keeps daily totals and information about collection coverage for 13 months by default. Authorized administrators can see the reports. You can enable Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control in your browser to opt out without affecting portal access.

data.name: Privacy_PdfAccess
data.value: After signing in, you can see basic report details when available. Enter your portal password again each time you view or download a released laboratory or radiology PDF, including a Red Star laboratory PDF.

data.name: Privacy_StorageAndAudit
data.value: The portal encrypts sensitive fields in Red Star records and stores report PDFs in encrypted private storage. Staff access depends on their assigned permissions. The portal logs report views and downloads, and certain administrative and account actions.

data.name: Privacy_HivConfidentiality
data.value: Republic Act No. 11166 (Philippine HIV and AIDS Policy Act) protects the confidentiality of HIV testing, exposure, status, and related care. Disclosure of confidential HIV information requires written consent unless an exception under that law applies.

data.name: Privacy_Rights
data.value: Under the Data Privacy Act of 2012, you have the right to be informed and can request access to or correction of your personal data. Where the law allows, you can object to processing or request blocking or deletion. You can raise a concern with the DRMC Data Protection Officer or file a complaint with the National Privacy Commission.

data.name: Privacy_EmailSafety
data.value: Keep passwords, verification codes, and medical records out of email. Ask DRMC how to share sensitive information securely.

data.name: Privacy_TermsAccount
data.value: Use accurate registration details and your own identity documents. Review any information extracted from your ID and correct errors before submitting. Keep your password and verification codes private and sign out when you use a shared device.

data.name: Privacy_TermsServices
data.value: Use your account to access your own records and public hospital guidance. Respect the privacy of other patients and keep their accounts and records private.

data.name: Privacy_TermsCare
data.value: Follow your healthcare team’s instructions. Discuss your results and treatment questions with them. For urgent symptoms or an emergency, seek immediate in-person care.

data.name: Privacy_TermsChoice
data.value: Registration requires the processing described in the privacy notice, including identity verification and storage of any ID photos you submit. You can leave signup and continue to browse public information.
